parameters.jsCode: const decide = $('Classify SDR Closer Human').item.json; const original = (decide.response && decide.response.reply_text) || ''; let candidate = null; try { const content = $json.choices && $json.choices[0] && $json.choices[0].message && $json.choices[0].message.content; if (content) { const parsed = JSON.parse(content); if (parsed && typeof parsed.reply_text === 'string') candidate = parsed.reply_text.trim(); } } catch (err) { candidate = null; } const unsafePatterns = [/r\$\s?\d/i, /confirmad[oa]/i, /fechad[oa]\s+(o\s+)?(hor[aá]rio|agendamento|valor)/i, /\b\d{1,2}[:h]\d{0,2}\b.*\b(confirmad|marcad|agendad)/i]; const isUnsafe = candidate ? unsafePatterns.some((re) => re.test(candidate)) : true; const finalText = (!isUnsafe && candidate) ? candidate : original; return [{ json: { ...decide, response: { ...decide.response, reply_text: finalText } } }];
